visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white ink illustration depicting two men in a desolate landscape. One man sits on the ground sketching on a pad, while the other stands beside a large stone slab inscribed with the word 'FIN'. Behind the slab, a tall, tripod-like mechanical structure with a wide, flat top stands against a cloudy sky with birds. In the foreground, a strange, tentacled, organic mass lies on the ground.
visualDescription.visualObjectsEn: Large stone slab with the word 'FIN', tripod mechanical machine, sketchbook, pen, large feather or quill, tentacled organic creature, birds in the sky.
visualDescription.recognizableCharactersOrPeopleEn: Two men, one seated and one standing, both dressed in simple, somewhat disheveled clothing.
visualDescription.uncertaintyNotes: The exact nature of the mechanical structure and the organic mass is ambiguous, as they appear to be fantastical or science-fiction elements. The artist's signature 'Alvim-Corrêa' is visible in the bottom left corner.
